subject: Neural Machine Translation
source_sentence: Neural machine translation (briefly, NMT), which is built upon deep neural networks, has gained rapid progress in recent years (Bahdanau et al., 2014; Sutskever et al., 2014; Sennrich et al., 2015; He et al., 2016a; Sennrich et al., 2016a; Xia et al., 2017; Wang et al., 2019) and achieved signifi- cant improvement in translation quality.
